//: What people of this mod do about a blow struck without cause (15 §12, 13 §8.2): an offence is content. Everything here starts from a percept, `perceived` with a blow it carried (`hit_landed`: seen, heard, or felt by the one it landed on, `perceptions/event_signals.json`), and reads only what the one who perceived it believes: whom it took the striker for (`event.about_actor`, the persona it saw, so a disguised striker is remembered as the disguise), and how it regards the one struck. (`event.about_actor ?? self` below only satisfies the linter: the condition has made sure it is someone else.) A blow nobody made out the striker of has no consequence. The rules are in the group `social_life`: the setting `core:social_life` false switches them off with the rest.
doc: How `self` comes to regard someone it saw or felt strike without cause, by its own mind's weights: held hostile, as much as its `duty`, where its duty outweighs its `caution` (the watch, a brawler); otherwise feared, as much as its caution (townsfolk, a dog). A relation it already holds more strongly is kept. Whom it takes `toward` for is whom it holds it toward (15 §9.1).

//: A blow seen, heard or felt: the one who struck is taken against, unless the one struck is someone the witness itself holds hostile or fears (a blow against a foe is no offence to it), or the striker itself (what a blow jars back into the hand that struck it, 07 §6.3). The first time it puts this striker to such a blow it remembers it as `core:unprovoked_blow`; a member of the watch reports it to the watch, whose every member is told at once (15 §9.2); one of the townsfolk not played by anyone, and afraid (its caution not outweighed by its duty), shouts for the watch, an alarm (`core:alarm`, a call that carries a report) heard by whoever is in earshot, however far from attention (D-934), which a watchman who hears it answers and passes to the watch (`core:heed_alarm`, `core:pass_alarms_to_the_watch`). Calling for help and running are its mind's goals (`flee_danger`).
if: not is_null(event.about_actor) and event.about_actor != self and (event.signal == 'core:touch' or is_null(about) or (about != event.about_actor and not (self.hostile(about) or self.fears(about))))
doc: Someone who perceives a blow and makes out who struck it, against itself or against someone else it neither holds hostile nor fears (the jar of a blow into the striker's own fist is no offence), takes against the striker (`core:take_against`); the first time, it remembers the striker for it (`core:unprovoked_blow`), and tells its group: the watch by reporting to it, the townsfolk who fear the striker by shouting for the watch.

//: Group knowledge is consulted on recognising someone (15 §9.2): a watchman told that a persona struck someone without cause takes against it when he next comes to perceive it. So does anyone who heard it shouted.
if: not is_null(about) and self.memory_confidence('core:unprovoked_blow') != null and self.remembers_actor(about, 'core:unprovoked_blow') and not self.hostile(about) and not self.fears(about)
doc: Someone who comes to perceive a persona it remembers, seen or told, as having struck without cause (`core:unprovoked_blow`) takes against it (`core:take_against`).

Someone told of a blow struck without cause takes against the striker at once if it already perceives them: the same as recognising them (`core:recognise_an_offender`), for whoever is in sight when the news comes.

entities.where: it != self and perceives(self, it) and self.remembers_actor(it, 'core:unprovoked_blow') and not self.hostile(it) and not self.fears(it)

doc: Shouting for the watch after seeing someone struck.
